question: What is the rank of India in the 2025 Global Peace Index?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**115**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• 19th Edition: Global Peace Index (GPI) 2025 released by IEP.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
The **Global Peace Index (GPI) 2025** was released by the **Institute for Economics and Peace (IEP)**.

 
 
• 
 
The **average global peacefulness** has **deteriorated by 0.36%** due to **geopolitical tensions and economic uncertainty**.

 
 
• 
 
**Iceland** remains the **most peaceful country** in the world — a title it has held since **2008**.

 
 
• 
 
The **Middle East and North Africa (MENA)** region is the **least peaceful**, for the **10th consecutive year**, with **4 of the bottom 10 countries**.

 
 
• 
 
**India ranks 115th** with a **GPI score of 2.229**, marking a **0.58% improvement** in peacefulness.

 
 
• 
 
**India ranks higher than**:

 
 
• 
 
**Bangladesh** (#123)

 
 
• 
 
**Pakistan** (#144)

 
 
• 
 
**Afghanistan** (#158)

 
 
 
 
• 
 
The GPI ranks **163 countries and territories** based on **23 indicators** in **3 domains**:

 
 
• 
 
**Societal safety and security**

 
 
• 
 
**Ongoing domestic and international conflict**

 
 
• 
 
**Militarisation**
